mainEntity.name: What is an AI PR consultant and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: An AI PR consultant is a senior communications specialist who runs media strategy for companies building AI products, AI infrastructure or AI-adjacent technology. The right fit is a fractional senior operator rather than a generalist agency, because the person who understands your technical differentiation, builds the journalist relationships and pitches the editors is the person you hired. Shilika Jain works directly with AI founders for $5K–$12K/month and has placed companies including Gaia AI in Forbes and Decrypt. See the full service scope at AI startup PR.

mainEntity.name: How much does an AI PR consultant cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional senior AI PR consultant runs $5K–$12K per month. A traditional AI PR agency charges $15K–$45K per month because the retainer funds a multi-person account team, not more senior access. A focused launch sprint runs $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks and covers positioning, embargo strategy, tier-1 outreach and podcast bookings. The full pricing breakdown is in AI PR agency pricing and packages 2026.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets and deliverables does AI PR actually produce?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-1 AI and tech: Forbes, AI Magazine, Decrypt, Benzinga, VentureBeat, TechCrunch. Crypto-adjacent AI: CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, The Block, Blockworks, The Defiant. Podcasts: introductions to shows your target investors and enterprise buyers actually listen to, not vanity downloads. Bylines and op-eds under your founders' names in relevant beats. Coverage depends on a real news hook and a story editors want to run, not a paid wire distribution.

mainEntity.name: What does the process and timeline look like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Week one is a teardown: your current press footprint, technical differentiation and the one story worth telling. Week two is narrative: the category framing, three-sentence thesis and the journalist and podcast map. Weeks three and four are launch execution: embargoes, outreach and the first wave of placements. Month two onward is sustained coverage, AI-citation tracking and compound positioning. See the full playbook at AI startup PR in 2026.
